class: exact-oracle known-answer study; zero model calls; fully deterministic

this_series.object: exact deterministic mechanism-vs-faithful-parent comparison over generated finite decision families with hidden known answers
this_series.arms: deterministic algorithms only (no language model is called at any point)
this_series.primary_question: is the active language too coarse, or is the problem merely unsolved

not_to_be_confused_with.object: language-model solver arms over generated formal-discovery tasks, 1712 tasks x 5 arms = 8560 dispatches
not_to_be_confused_with.relation: prior, not comparator. That campaign used the same study labels fg10..fg80 for a different object. This design does not replicate it, does not contradict it, and shares no generator, oracle, arm or task with it. Its fg70 stratum (arm spread 0.825-0.900) is used here only as the prior that FG70 is the most discriminative non-frontier study of the family.
not_to_be_confused_with.do_not_edit: the fmfg-r2 receipts are frozen and are not modified by this lane

question: When a registered decision family collides under the active formalism F, is the correct repair an existing parent formalism, one missing variable/observation, a local patch/scope condition, a representation change, a candidate new primitive, or no change at all?
collision_diagnostic: C_F = {(i,j) : q_F(x_i) = q_F(x_j) and J(x_i) != J(x_j)}; a non-empty C_F proves only that F is too coarse for that registered decision family

critical_metric.name: false_formalism_invention
critical_metric.definition: an arm emits NEW_PRIMITIVE when the truth is any cheaper tier

generator.verification: every planted instance is re-derived by exhaustive tier search (both oracle methods) before emission; a planted instance whose cheapest feasible tier is not the intended one is rejected and resampled

decoys.principle: each stratum carries structure that would reward a more expensive answer
decoys.maximal_invention_temptation: on every stratum whose truth is PARENT_FORMALISM_SUFFICIENT, ADD_ONE_OBSERVATION, LOCAL_PATCH or REPRESENTATION_CHANGE the instance registers a relation whose connected components coincide with the decision classes, so a new primitive is always available and always adequate; the suite therefore measures parsimony under maximal temptation, not the difficulty of finding a working primitive
decoys.near_miss_parent: a registered parent leaving exactly one collision is included wherever one exists
decoys.near_miss_observation: an observable resolving all but one collision is recorded and counted

G0a_KNOWN_ANSWER.rule: six hand-authored fixtures (one per terminal) reproduced by the oracle, by M and by the federation

G0b_ORACLE_SELF_AGREEMENT.rule: method A (signature buckets + bitmask cover) equals method B (set-partition meet) on every instance

G0c_NULL_CALIBRATION.rule: random control <= 0.25; M against within-split shuffled labels <= 0.30; planted positive C_ALWAYS_INVENT false-invention rate >= 0.50 (must trip G2M); planted positive M_MINUS_ORDER_AND_GATE false-invention rate > 0 (must trip G2M); planted positive C_NEVER_CHANGE missed-deficit rate >= 0.50 (must trip G2)

G1a_FEDERATION_REPRODUCES_M.rule: terminal identity >= 0.995 and no stratum discordance > 0.05

G1b_M_ADVANTAGE.rule: paired exact two-sided McNemar p <= 0.05 with M ahead; Holm across the FG10..FG70 family

G2_ANTI_CONSERVATISM.rule: M's missed-deficit count <= the federation's over instances whose truth is not NO_CHANGE; paired with the planted positive C_NEVER_CHANGE, because every arm's first move is the shared collision check and the counter is otherwise structurally unreachable

G2M_ANTI_INVENTION.rule: M's false-invention count <= the federation's AND rate <= 0.02; hard-fails if any non-NEW_PRIMITIVE stratum has an empty denominator

G3_MECHANISM_BY_OMISSION.rule: every stratum has an omission ablation that removes a mechanism the stratum needs and must degrade relative to M; plus the 2x2 factorial omission of the registered cost order and of the fail-closed admission gate, reported unconditionally
G3_MECHANISM_BY_OMISSION.admission_gate_note: the fail-closed admission gate can only ever block, so removing it cannot degrade the stratum where invention is correct; NEW_PRIMITIVE is therefore attributed to omitting the escalation tier itself (M_MINUS_INVENTION_TIER, like-for-like with the other five), and the gate's own mechanism is measured on the anti-invention axis by the 2x2 factorial

gate_evaluation_discipline: every gate reports the number of instances actually evaluated beside its violation count, and every no-alarm assertion is paired with a planted positive that must trip it: PLANTED_POSITIVE_ANTI_INVENTION_GATE_FIRES (G2M), PLANTED_POSITIVE_ANTI_CONSERVATISM_GATE_FIRES (G2), EVERY_STRATUM_HAS_A_DEGRADING_OMISSION_ABLATION (G3), and ANTI_INVENTION_DENOMINATOR_IS_NON_EMPTY_AND_TEMPTING (G2M denominator)
no_rescue_clause: no stratum weight, oracle rule, arm, seed, gate constant or count changes after the protected results file exists; a protected result is never re-run under a new seed; a lane defect found mid-run halts the lane, is receipted, and re-freezes as V2
